case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as long-term partnerships are the foundation of our 12-year relationship. In return for this extended commitment, we are prepared to make a substantial concession and offer €51.30 per unit. We have selected the option with 30-day payment terms, as maintaining reliable cash flow is essential for our family-run foundry.

For our Angebot, we present a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms, and our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

It is always a pleasure working with your team to support our shared history.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We note your request to delay the effective date to April 2027. Our quote lists our standard terms, and our general terms and conditions apply. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

As a fair compromise, we propose an effective date of 1 February 2027. With this adjustment, we can offer a revised price of €50.90 per unit, maintaining the 30-day payment terms that are vital for our family business. 

For our main proposal, we offer a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Alternatively, we can offer a package with a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. With valid from 1 February 2027: €50.90 per unit.

Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement and are willing to take another step towards you. For generations, our foundry has valued the strong partnership with your company, and we always aim to find a good way forward together.

We can offer €51.00 per unit for the package with 30-day payment terms and an effective date of 1 April 2027. Under this Angebot, our terms include a price of €51.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. 

Maintaining the 30-day payment term remains important for our family-run business. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our long and successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
